name: SOFT CIRCUIT
description: A softly coupled pair of phase-modulated tones.
principle: Slow interval attraction rather than a note sequence; mild folding and short stereo motion.

name: PAPER WINDOWS
description: Paper-like noise taps find a small resonant space.
principle: Five-in-twelve noise gestures meet a slower plucked comb; finite early reflections, no reverb tank.

name: BORROWED LIGHT
description: A rubbing surface lends its spectrum to a held harmonic voice.
principle: A new oscillator spectrum remembers intermittent captures; small frequency-shifted interference changes the held light.

name: VELVET ENGINE
description: A fuzzy pulse rhythm loses its expected accents.
principle: Five-in-eight articulation and a slower ducking cycle give one repeated tone different weights.

name: DEFERRED SIGNAL
description: Remembered chances arrive late as small ringing objects.
principle: Gate storage defers events, not pitches: the resonator strikes its current held pitch when the queue releases.

name: THREADS CROSS
description: A small moving swarm changes another voice from within.
principle: Physical group motion shapes spectral energy, low ring-modulation depth and actual stereo position.

name: SHATTERED CLOCK
description: A simple chip tone trips its own small digital failures.
principle: Actual detected attacks capture fragments while accumulated stress cracks their timing; stepped output remains restrained.

name: DISSENT IN GLASS
description: Three motions disagree about which glass tone should remain.
principle: A held consensus steers one pitch; dissent occasionally changes the audible source with a smooth crossfade.

name: BROKEN RADIO
description: A tuned band of electrical noise briefly loses contact.
principle: No melody: a slowly moving noise band and sparse transmission interruptions form a mid-register surface.

name: PASSING SHADOWS
description: A little machine passes between the present and a granular shadow.
principle: Long region changes, physically steered grain spread and occasional dry/memory switching preserve the source identity.
